problem:
Title: Hilbert Space Direct Sum is Hilbert Space

Let $\sequence {H_i}_{i \mathop \in I}$ be a [[Definition:Indexing Set|$I$-indexed family]] of [[Definition:Hilbert Space|Hilbert spaces]] over $\Bbb F \in \set {\R, \C}$.

Let $H = \ds \bigoplus_{i \mathop \in I} H_i$ be their [[Definition:Hilbert Space Direct Sum|Hilbert space direct sum]].

Then $H$ is a [[Definition:Hilbert Space|Hilbert space]].
